findings.current: That was why I’d wanted to give even more to my family, but…
findings.defect: The placement of “even more” makes it modify the amount being given, whereas 더 in context intensifies Taekyung’s desire to give the money to his family.
findings.rationale: Because the System might disappear and leave him without future earnings, Taekyung felt an even stronger desire to give the existing money to his family. The source does not clearly state that he wanted to give them a larger additional amount.
findings.replacement: That only made me want to give it to my family all the more, but…

summary: The chapter is highly faithful overall, with one minor scope ambiguity concerning Taekyung’s desire to give the money to his family.
